exampleEn: After several failed attempts, I decided to throw in the towel.
exampleKo: 여러 번의 실패한 시도 끝에 나는 포기하기로 했다.
gameExamples: She worked hard on her project, but when the deadline approached, she had to throw in the towel.
Even the best athletes can sometimes throw in the towel if they feel overwhelmed by the competition.
After trying to fix the car for hours, he finally decided to throw in the towel and call a mechanic.
